svg.title: Generate a watermarked image by choosing among samples, then check images for the watermark
svg.desc: Sample several images for one prompt. Map them to a semantic space that random hyperplanes split into regions, each with a two-bit code. Sample a region from a distribution that depends on the group sizes and the secret key, which preserves the original output distribution, and release one of its images unchanged. To detect, embed an image, find its region and score that region with the same key: a cropped watermarked image lands in region 10 and scores 0.80, above the threshold of 0.70; an unwatermarked image lands in region 00 and scores 0.35, below it.

g.text: the secret key, to preserve the
Embed each image, find its region
Score its region with the same key, compare to a threshold
Watermarked images are much more likely to score high.
